stemMarkdown: 23 workers, each working 10 hours a day, can complete a job in 18 days. How many days will 10 workers, each working 8 hours a day, take to complete the same job? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Total work $= 23 \times 18 \times 10$ worker-hours $= 4140$. With 10 workers at 8 hours/day, days needed $= \dfrac{4140}{10\times8} = 51.75$.
